lineage.transformation_summary: Native ResearchOS handoff protocol that consumes a separately configured, read-only MCP connector without copying private thread data or provider credentials into the plugin.

task_contract.user_job: Continue a local Codex task in another AI client from a bounded, redacted, provenance-aware thread projection.
inputs: A separately configured connector exposing list_codex_threads and read_codex_thread
invariants: The local Codex session remains source authority
Only user and assistant text is required
Developer/system content, reasoning, raw events, and tool payloads remain excluded
Plugin installation never implies connector readiness
Durable ResearchOS writeback remains a separate Review action
confirmation_gates: The user chooses the thread reference
The user confirms before any durable ResearchOS writeback or public reuse
completion_criteria: Thread identity and connector readiness are explicit
All pages needed for the requested scope are accounted for
Redaction and truncation limits are reported
The continuation answer distinguishes source content from new inference
failure_modes: Plugin is installed but the connector is not configured
Connector schema is stale or missing a required tool
Thread UUID is invalid or absent from allowed storage
A page is truncated, cursor-bound to another thread, or cannot be verified
recovery: Reconnect or refresh the ChatGPT connector after a tool-schema change
Request a canonical UUID or codex://threads URI
Continue pagination with the returned cursor and preserve receipts
Fall back to user-pasted excerpts when local access is unavailable
task_contract.retention_rule: Retain only if real handoffs reduce manual context loss without broadening local read authority or obscuring truncation and redaction.

admission.retirement_condition: Retire if a supported host-native handoff provides equal local-only authority, bounded pagination, redaction receipts, and public/private parity with lower maintenance cost.

authority.source: The selected local Codex session and the connector's redacted context receipts remain source authority.
authority.candidate: Continuation summaries, inferred decisions, and proposed ResearchOS updates remain candidates until reviewed.
authority.confirmation: Human confirmation is required before durable ResearchOS writeback or public reuse of thread-derived content.
authority.save_target: Use answer or artifact by default; any durable memory uses the existing Review flow and this plugin owns no storage.

task.budget: quick/standard/evidence; page only until the named continuation question is supported

en.name: Continue a Codex thread
en.goal: Continue a selected local Codex task through a bounded, redacted, receipt-bearing connector without exposing arbitrary local files.
en.user_input_hint: Provide a canonical UUID or codex://threads/<UUID>, the continuation question, and the configured connector name if more than one is available.
en.output: readiness state + context receipt + bounded continuation briefing + omissions + next action
next_steps: Check that the plugin is installed and the connector is configured and verified
Read only the pages needed for the continuation question
Report redaction, truncation, and inference boundaries before continuing

zh-CN.name: 续接 Codex task
zh-CN.goal: 通过有边界、会脱敏并返回 receipt 的连接器续接指定本地 Codex task，同时不开放任意本地文件读取。
zh-CN.user_input_hint: 提供 canonical UUID 或 codex://threads/<UUID>、希望继续的问题；若配置了多个连接器，再说明连接器名称。
zh-CN.output: 就绪状态 + context receipt + 有边界的续接简报 + 省略项 + 下一步
next_steps: 确认插件已安装，连接器已配置且验证通过
只分页读取回答当前续接问题所需的内容
继续前报告脱敏、截断和推断边界
